response.sql: WITH per_name AS (SELECT r.name AS name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.driverId) AS cnt FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM per_name) SELECT AVG(p.avg_points) AS avg_of_avg_points, AVG(p.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(p.cnt - o.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM per_name p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.cnt > o.avg_cnt
